content: x.com marks promoted content with div[data-testid="placementTracking"]; filter lists pair it with a Promoted/Ad text or SVG check. Confirmed in shipping source of insin/control-panel-for-twitter (MIT, v4.24.1): Selectors.PROMOTED_TWEET_CONTAINER = '[data-testid="placementTracking"]' and getTweetType() returns 'PROMOTED_TWEET' when $tweet.closest(that) matches. Timeline cell is [data-testid="cellInnerDiv"], positioned by transform: translateY. CPFT hides items by toggling a .HiddenTweet class on the cell's firstElementChild (not the transform-positioned cell) and a single central stylesheet rule '.HiddenTweet, .HiddenTweet + [role="separator"] { display: none !important }'.
